objective: Repair three defects the Founder hit while attempting Certification Test One, all found on 2026-08-12 and all in the Founder-facing conversation surface rather than in IRIS reasoning. ONE: src/voice-interface.ts treated the bare word `stop` as an emergency-stop command. That check runs from the failure path over the Founder's own submitted text and revokes the governed operator session and desktop control, so the ordinary safety instruction 'Stop before any protected effect' in a certification objective revoked Founder access when an unrelated provider call failed; a transient blip became a session revocation. TWO: packages/model-gateway routed the read-only capability repository.inspect to the coding role. The coding specialist was handed a trusted evidence block naming branch and HEAD and answered 'I cannot inspect the repository due to insufficient access permissions' on three consecutive Founder runs, while the same objective and evidence under gpt-oss:20b returned the correct branch and exact 40-character revision. THREE: the conversation transcript had no height ceiling, no scroll container of its own, and no auto-scroll, so the page grew without bound and pushed the composer below the fold, forcing the Founder to scroll to reach the input after every turn. Not repaired here and recorded as observed: the turn failed with COGNITIVE_ORCHESTRATOR_UNAVAILABLE because the model inventory read did not include the primary model, most plausibly a slow Ollama tags call under load against its 10 second cap.
